rows.indian_institute_of_technology_delhi_iit: Rs. 39,420 to Rs. 51,420 per month (consolidated fellowship / pay-slab) plus HRA @ 30%
Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi, New Delhi

Master's Degree in any discipline with First Class from a recognised University/Institution and minimum 08 years of relevant experience in administrative and management-related activities, preferably in an IIT, Institution of Higher Education, University, or other reputed educational institution.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. IITD/IRD/316/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIT Delhi notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in any discipline with First Class from a recognised University/Institution; minimum 08 years of relevant experience in administrative and management-related activities, preferably in an IIT, Institution of Higher Education, University, or other reputed educational institution. Experience: Minimum 08 years of relevant experience in administrative and management-related activities, preferably in an IIT, Institution of Higher Education, University, or other reputed educational institution Other conditions: Only Indian nationals may apply Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills Proficiency in MS Office, particularly MS Word and Excel Experience in office administration, management, and administrative coordination Ability to handle official correspondence, maintain records, prepare reports and coordinate institutional activities Good public relations and liaisoning skills Desirable: Substantial experience in administrative and management functions in an institution of higher education, particularly an IIT or equivalent institution, will be preferred Excellent organisational, coordination, communication and public relations skills, with the ability to independently handle multiple administrative responsibilities efficiently

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Salary of a selected retired/superannuated government employee will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. Appointment on contractual basis with consolidated pay Renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier Project duration up to 21/08/2036

rows.event: Last date for submitting completed applications by email (5.00 p.m.)

content_sections.heading: How Will IIT Delhi Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Short-listing of eligible candidates (IIT Delhi may fix higher criteria) Offline interview for short-listed candidates IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates Names of short-listed candidates will be displayed on http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted with offline interview details

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 Complete information on educational qualifications with percentage of marks/division Details of work experience

Send the duly filled form to [email protected] by 23-11-2026, 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Assistant (Admin).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 23 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 39,420 to Rs. 51,420 per month (consolidated fellowship / pay-slab) plus HRA @ 30%.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in any discipline with First Class from a recognised University/Institution and minimum 08 years of relevant experience in administrative and management-related activities, preferably in an IIT, Institution of Higher Education, University, or other reputed educational institution.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian nationals may apply. Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly MS Word and Excel. Experience in office administration, management, and administrative coordination.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Short-listing of eligible candidates (IIT Delhi may fix higher criteria). Offline interview for short-listed candidates. IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates. Names of short-listed candidates will be displayed on http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted with offline interview details.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on contractual basis with consolidated pay. Renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. Project duration up to 21/08/2036.

faq.answer: Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi, New Delhi.
